title: Contain the Rosette /design multi-ring emitter behind RMOS authority (CF2 Phase B)
intent: Move POST /api/rmos/rosette/design from LIVE_UNGOVERNED to fail-closed manufacturing-output containment: resolve authority exactly once for the complete design, before the ring loop and all generation, and persist the single combined program. Containment only — not qualification, not new physics, not a route redesign. Depends on Phase A (/export-cnc, merged as 2bd9102a).
behavior_change: POST /api/rmos/rosette/design now derives one complete-design feasibility summary and resolves compute_rosette_feasibility (via require_manufacturing_output_authority, tool_id=rosette:design) once, before any segmentation/slice/CNC-export/G-code/job-id work. A blocking decision (RED/UNKNOWN/ERROR) returns HTTP 409 SAFETY_BLOCKED with no ring output and exactly one BLOCKED audit artifact; a permitted decision generates every ring as before, persists the single combined_gcode once, and stamps X-Run-ID / X-ToolBox-Lane: governed / X-GCode-SHA256. The missing/empty-rings early return is preserved and creates no authority or persistence artifact. Existing response fields and ring order are unchanged except for governed headers. /export-cnc is untouched.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Added _rosette_design_feasibility_summary (pure complete-design aggregation) to rosette_output_authority.py and generalized the module docstring. Wired require_manufacturing_output_authority(tool_id=rosette:design) into design_rosette once before the loop; injected Response; preserved the empty-rings early return; persisted combined_gcode once with meta={ring_count, ring_ids, job_ids}; set governed headers. Added tests/rmos/test_cf2_rosette_design_containment.py (RDS-01..38 + pattern regressions). Updated Phase A REX-14 to recognize /design's transition (keeping /export-cnc governed). Updated the probe live-ungoverned count 14->13. Regenerated the inventory JSON/MD so /design moves LIVE_UNGOVERNED -> FAIL_CLOSED.
diff_articulation.why: POST /api/rmos/rosette/design was CONFIRMED_EMITTER / LIVE_UNGOVERNED: it generated per-ring and combined G-code with no server-side authority and no governed persistence. This converges it onto the existing RMOS manufacturing-output authority so a blocked design emits no ring output and a permitted design is persisted once under the exact authorizing decision.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No prior change gates /design. Phase A governed only /export-cnc. The shared authority/persistence services exist but /design did not call them. This adds the missing single pre-loop gate and the single combined-program persistence.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No machining physics, geometry algorithms, G-code generators, feasibility rules/thresholds/risk mappings, authentication, shared authority-service semantics, or /export-cnc behavior. The shared classifier app/ci/manufacturing_output_classify.py was NOT modified. Response body fields and ring order are unchanged except governed headers.
diff_articulation.why_structural_extraction: The complete-design summary helper lives alongside the single-ring helper in rosette_output_authority.py (no new module). The route uses compute_rosette_feasibility only through the shared require_manufacturing_output_authority.

pattern_disposition.summary: Owner ruling (A): pattern affects the emitted program via tile-count parity but the evaluator does not consume pattern_type; include a truthful pattern_type plus pattern_types diagnostic, do not claim the evaluator assessed pattern.
pattern_disposition.pattern_affects_emitted_program: YES — reproduced: identical geometry across patterns yields tile_count 32 (checkerboard/spanish_wave/herringbone; force_even) vs 31 (radial/solid), producing different G-code (sha a1bb57ec… vs bed40711…). /design passes the ring dict (carrying pattern) into compute_tile_segmentation.
pattern_disposition.evaluator_consumes_pattern_type: NO — reproduced: feasibility_scorer.score_design_feasibility never references pattern_type; compute_rosette_feasibility returns identical YELLOW/81.82 for omitted/checkerboard/mixed/radial.
pattern_disposition.authority_basis: geometry (outer/inner diameter), ring_count, material, and RPM.
pattern_disposition.summary_representation: pattern_type = the single normalized pattern when uniform, else 'mixed'; pattern_types = sorted unique normalized patterns (an ignored extra field retained in the persisted request_summary as diagnostics).
pattern_disposition.future_work: Closing evaluator pattern-awareness (scoring on tile pattern) is separate future work; not repaired in this increment.

commands_run: cd services/api && python -m pytest tests/rmos/test_cf2_rosette_output_containment.py tests/rmos/test_cf2_probe_output_containment.py tests/test_rosette_cnc_export_endpoint_smoke.py tests/test_rmos_rosette_cnc_smoke.py tests/test_rmos_endpoint_smoke.py tests/rmos/test_manufacturing_authority_stage2.py tests/rmos/test_rmos_feasibility_authority.py -q --no-cov
proofs: Authority runs exactly once, outside and before the ring loop and all generation/persistence (AST tests RDS-11/13; misordered fixture RDS-14; runtime once RDS-12/25).

Blocked design (RED/UNKNOWN/ERROR) -> 409 SAFETY_BLOCKED, no generator, no partial/first-ring program, exactly one BLOCKED artifact, no gcode hash, governed refusal headers without X-GCode-SHA256 (RDS-15..22).

Permitted multi-ring design generates each ring once, persists exactly one OK artifact, and X-GCode-SHA256 == sha256(combined_gcode) == persisted hash, with matching run ids and real YELLOW preserved (RDS-23..31).
Artifact meta lists every ring_id and job_id; persisted request_summary retains pattern_type and pattern_types (RDS-32, pattern regression).

Summary aggregates the complete design (max outer / min inner, exact ring_count, route-level material/RPM) with no invented depth/tool-diameter/feed/petal (RDS-02..07); invalid geometry fails before authority (RDS-08).
Inventory: /design LIVE_UNGOVERNED -> FAIL_CLOSED (rosette:design, before_generation); /export-cnc unchanged; live-ungoverned 14->13; permitted-by-authority 0; probe census unchanged (RDS-33..38).
Pattern affects emitted program (tile parity) but not evaluator risk (pattern regressions).
verification.hardware: No physical-machine execution and no manufacturing output. G-code is generated in tests only and never sent to a controller.

files.intent: Authority once before the /design loop; persist combined_gcode once; governed headers; preserve empty-rings return.
files.behavior_change: Blocking -> 409 no output; permitted -> persisted combined program + governed headers. /export-cnc untouched.

Update REX-14 to recognize /design transition; /export-cnc contracts preserved.
files.behavior_change: Assertion update only; no Phase A contract weakened.
Count assertion only; probe invariants preserved.
Generated route facts for one row.

findings: MEDIUM: adds a fail-closed authority gate to a live multi-ring manufacturing emitter. Risk concentrates in single-evaluation cardinality, authority-before-loop ordering, partial-output prevention, and combined-hash identity, all covered by direct tests. No _experimental/ files touched.

LOW: pattern affects the emitted program via tile-count parity but the manufacturing-output evaluator does not consume pattern_type; disclosed as a documented limitation (pattern_type/pattern_types are truthful but decision-neutral), not repaired here.
architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Containment only. Shared classifier and evaluator unchanged; /export-cnc unchanged; evaluator pattern-awareness deferred to future work.
